name: minimal
title: Minimal
description: Typed commands change a rotating primitive.
controls: Open console, then use echo, color, or spin. Tab completes; Up and Down recall history.

name: quake_drawer
title: Quake drawer
description: A top drawer reverses its slide continuously.
controls: Use scene speed, scene reset, and motion reduced. The toggle key opens and closes the drawer.

name: source_window
title: Source window
description: Drag, resize, and select output in a movable window.
controls: Drag the title bar or lower-right grip. Close releases editing focus.

name: clap_commands
title: Clap commands
description: Existing derive and builder parsers drive visible scene effects.
controls: Use scene spawn, scene light, scene rotate, or announce. --help and --version print without exiting.

name: crt_workstation
title: CRT workstation
description: The real console texture appears on a procedural workstation.
controls: Click the glass or Edit screen. Use HELP, DIR, CD, TYPE, and CRT controls. Escape returns to the desk.

name: kitchen_sink
title: Kitchen sink
description: Capture filters, retained log formatting, policy, and presentation controls.
controls: Use demo --help, demo theme light, demo layout compact, or demo burst. Up and Down recall accepted public commands.
